simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מְדוּרָה (H4071) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מְדוּרָה (mᵉdûwrâh) means a pile of fuel First listed occurrence: Ezek 24 9.

definitions.full: H4071. medurah מְדוּרָה noun feminine pile (of wood, etc.) ׳מ Ezek 24:9 ; הרבה ועצים אֵשׁ מְדֻרָתָהּ Isa 30:33 = pyre (so Ges Hi De Che Brd; Ew Di its circuit, compass ).
definitions.rootNote: or מְדֻרָה ; from 1752 in the sense of accumulation ;
